name: STIHL MS 881
blurb: 3/8″ .063″ on a 21″ bar (75 drive links, 36 RS3 75) and .404″ .063″ from 25″ to 41″ (80–123 drive links, 46 RS), per STIHL's 2025 chart.
intro: The MS 881 Magnum and MS 881 R are the current large STIHL saws in the 2025 chain chart (the older MS 880 is a separate page). The chart lists one 3/8″ .063″ setup, 21″ with 75 drive links (36 RS3 75), and .404″ .063″ loops: 80 links on 25″, 91 on 30″, then two 36″ bars (108 and 104 links) and two 41″ bars (both 123 links, different bar part numbers). .404″ chain in this chart is yellow-labeled.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 36 RS3 75 with recommended bar 3002 000 9123. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5.2 mm (13/64″) file for 3/8″ chain. Oregon's 2020 filing chart gives 7/32″ for standard 3/8″ chain (types 72, 73, 75).

STIHL's chart lists chain 46 RS 80 with recommended bar 3002 000 9731. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5.5 mm (7/32″) file for .404″ chain. Bars marked with an asterisk are yellow-labeled: the chart says a reduced-kickback bar is not listed at that length. .404″ loops in this block are marked with a double asterisk (yellow-labeled).
bars.label: 25″ (.404″, 80 drive links, bar 3002 000 9731)
